description: §4.15 / §40.8 / §20.8.4 — `keep-alive` is the FIFTH member of the `<page>` per-route attribute set (S314). It compiles clean: no `E-PAGE-INVALID-ATTR`, and no incidental `W-ATTR-001` (the attribute is registered on the `<page>` surface, not merely tolerated). Pinned because this is a NEWLY-ACCEPTING surface — the form was REJECTED until S314, so without a case the acceptance is unprotected and a future tightening of the attribute set would silently re-break it.
rationale: §40.8: "The five per-route attributes are `db=`, `auth=`, `csrf=`, `ratelimit=`, `keep-alive` (§20.8.4); any other attribute on `<page>` fires `E-PAGE-INVALID-ATTR`." §20.8.4: "A route MAY opt into `keep-alive` (`<page keep-alive>`)." The AUTHORING surface is what this case pins; the §20.8.4 runtime cache remains Nominal and is pinned separately by route-region-cn10-keepalive-reentry.
